eps.t: The Case of the Missing Scrolls
eps.o: 1871. A wayward young Sherlock Holmes is sent to Oxford to keep out of trouble, but he soon finds himself the prime suspect in a police investigation that threatens his entire future.

eps.t: The Case of the Burnt Photograph
eps.o: Sherlock is thrown into jail. He has to clear his name or face the gallows.

eps.t: The Case of the Unarmed Man
eps.o: The game's afoot. With another murder and two professors missing, it's a race against time for Sherlock and Moriarty to find them before the killer does.

eps.t: The Case of the Missing Button
eps.o: Sherlock returns to his childhood home in search of answers.

eps.t: The Case of Young Sherlock Holmes
eps.o: Years after a tragic accident that tore the Holmes family apart, Moriarty and Sherlock come to blows as they investigate that fateful day.

eps.t: The Case of the Killing Jar
eps.o: As Sherlock digs deeper into the Oxford murders, he discovers a shocking connection.

eps.t: The Case of the Two Corners
eps.o: An impossible ultimatum challenges Sherlock's loyalties.
Family ties and friendships are tested in the Holmes family reunion from hell.
